pinned_at_note: Merge of main (PR #338 runtime_journal pin advance) into testing/qualification-v1. Combines the owner-authorized PR #152 advance (b1dd503: m4_protocol portability pins) with the owner-authorized PR #338 advance (3d9d4b9: runtime_journal init-admission retry). No protected bytes are changed by this merge; every pin below matches the merged tree's committed blob.
justification: Owner-authorized protected ownership advance for PR #152 after independent qualification re-review (comment 5733691134) and retained first-attempt triage. The only protected runtime byte changes move SANDBOX_* wire/exit constants out of Linux-only _isolated_child.py imports and into new platform-neutral residual/factory/m4_protocol.py so normal Station/Factory imports work on Windows without changing constant values, sandbox authority, verifier semantics, UNKNOWN/BLOCKED handling, or isolation policy. m4_protocol.py is added to the core protected set because the protected safety/sandbox modules now depend on those constants. Fresh exact-head protected-owner, capable-runner, mutation, repository, and Qualification-v1 evidence remain required. M4 safety, sandbox and protocol remain fail-closed core invariants; runtime journal bounds durable attempts; verifier, sandbox, least-privilege, modular swarm and trust-gate surfaces remain pinned. This advance pins residual/factory/runtime_journal.py at blob 8f691b2a68d01d1df08ef7c79f8281805775b680, authorizing exactly one change: the constructor's idempotent schema/metadata write phase now retries lock admission under the same bounded WRITE_TRANSACTION_TIMEOUT_S budget and contention-only retry predicate that writer transactions already use (PR #185 left the constructor on the 0.2s no-retry path). Evidence: Qualification-v1 run 35397918674 attempt-1 real-concurrency database-is-locked failure in RuntimeJournal.__init__; local reproduction ~2-6% flake pre-fix, 60/60 passes post-fix; full tests/ suite green post-fix (1832 passed; the only 2 failures are pre-existing environment-dependent sandbox tests, byte-identical with and without the change). Non-weakening: no assertion, timeout, or fail-closed path was loosened; non-contention errors and deadline exhaustion still raise. Authorized by the protecting review on PR #338 per docs/status/FACTORY_OWNERSHIP_GATE.md and the PR #185 precedent. This merge resolution changes no protected file content and no pin scope; it only records both authorized advances on one manifest so the ownership gate can verify the merged head.
